about: Expected outputs computed by executing the model JavaScript embedded in the live Taste Check page (tools/oracle.js).

tolerances.intermediate: abs(got - expected) <= max(1e-6, 1e-6 * abs(expected)); informative, for debugging
tolerances.note_keys: set of keys should match exactly (conditions in REBUILD.md section 11); note wording is not tested
tolerances.missing_estimated: exact match (data-gap flags, REBUILD.md section 11.2); 'estimated' field lists are sorted
tolerances.null: sourness is null (not a number) when the acidity model is switched off
